sources.native_tools: Frozen official Qwen computer tool schema and actions.py:left_click_drag; coordinate=destination, pointer=start.

clipboard.copy_paste.scope: selected GUI content and intended destination; not a terminal
clipboard.copy_paste.steps: Confirm source selection; copy; navigate and focus the intended destination; paste; inspect the resulting content. Observe between stages.

clipboard.move_paste.scope: movable selected GUI content and intended destination; not a terminal
clipboard.move_paste.steps: Confirm source selection; cut; navigate and focus the intended destination; paste; inspect both source and destination. Observe between stages.

clipboard.transfer.scope: selected GUI content and intended destination; not a terminal
clipboard.transfer.steps: Choose copy to keep the source or cut to move it; never perform both. Confirm destination focus; paste; inspect the resulting content.

files.transfer.scope: GNOME Files or compatible file pane; verify focus
files.transfer.steps: Choose copy to keep the source, or cut to move it; never perform both. Navigate to destination; paste; inspect both locations. Observe between stages.

clipboard.copy.scope: selected GUI content; not a terminal
clipboard.copy.steps: Confirm selection; copy; inspect selection and clipboard availability.

clipboard.cut.scope: selected movable GUI content; not a terminal
clipboard.cut.steps: Confirm source; cut; keep the intended destination in view before pasting.

clipboard.paste.scope: intended destination field or file pane; not a terminal
clipboard.paste.steps: Confirm clipboard source and destination focus; paste once; inspect resulting content.

clipboard.verify.scope: the destination of the previous paste
clipboard.verify.steps: Inspect destination content and location; command return does not confirm the intended transfer. Do not paste again without checking.

files.copy.scope: GNOME Files or compatible file pane; verify focus
files.copy.steps: Select source; copy; navigate to intended destination; paste; inspect source and destination. Observe between steps.

files.move.scope: GNOME Files or compatible file pane; verify focus
files.move.steps: Select source; cut; navigate to intended destination; paste; inspect source and destination. Observe between steps.

files.rename.scope: selected file in GNOME Files or compatible file pane
files.rename.steps: Open rename; inspect selected basename and extension; enter the requested name; confirm and inspect the resulting name.

text.edit.scope: focused editable text field; not a canvas or terminal
text.edit.steps: Confirm editable focus and intended replacement range; select text only if replacing the whole field; type the user-provided value; inspect it.

text.replace_confirm.scope: editable field in a dialog with a verified Enter-to-confirm action
text.replace_confirm.steps: Verify editable focus and replacement range; select the field text only for full replacement; type; inspect the value; confirm; inspect the resulting state.

text.confirm.scope: focused dialog control with a known confirm action
text.confirm.steps: Inspect the entered value and active button before confirming; observe the resulting state.

ui.dismiss.steps: Check whether dismissing discards unsaved input; dismiss once and inspect focus.

history.undo.steps: Undo one edit; inspect the result before repeating.

document.find.scope: content window whose menu supports Find
document.find.steps: Open Find; enter the desired query; inspect matches and navigation controls.

document.open.scope: content window whose File menu supports Open
document.open.steps: Open the file dialog; choose the intended file; confirm and inspect the opened content.

document.save.scope: editable document whose File menu supports Save
document.save.steps: Save; handle any name/location dialog; inspect the saved result. Save is not format export.

navigation.down.steps: Scroll one page down and inspect the newly visible region.

navigation.up.steps: Scroll one page up and inspect the newly visible region.

capture.image.scope: application or desktop capture controls; confirm what will be captured
capture.image.steps: Use the visible capture command; choose the intended area/window; inspect capture settings and actual output location; open the resulting image.

export.file.scope: application with a visible Export command
export.file.steps: Use Export or Export As; choose format, name and location; review format options; confirm and reopen the output. Do not assume Save exports.

vlc.capture.scope: VLC 3.x Linux player; verify menu binding, not a text field
vlc.capture.steps: Use Video > Take Snapshot or its verified shortcut; inspect the configured snapshot location and resulting image. Do not assume a default path.

gimp.export.scope: GIMP image window; documented for 2.10, verify current menu binding
gimp.export.steps: Use File > Export As; choose format, name and location; inspect format options; confirm and reopen the output.

navigation.horizontal.scope: content pane with a visible horizontal scrollbar or supported horizontal scrolling
navigation.horizontal.steps: Confirm the pane and requested left/right direction; scroll a small amount using its visible control; inspect newly exposed content and the scrollbar position before repeating. Do not scroll vertically to reveal clipped columns.

view.zoom_value.scope: an exact zoom ratio is required and the editable zoom field is confirmed
view.zoom_value.steps: Only for a required precise ratio: focus the field, select text, type the value, confirm once; inspect actual scale and content. If already entered, only confirm/check; if confirmed, only check. Readable content needs no arbitrary target percentage.

view.zoom_confirm.scope: a zoom value was entered; verify the zoom field is still focused
view.zoom_confirm.steps: Do not select or type again. If the zoom field is still focused, confirm once; inspect actual scale/content. If focus changed, inspect the field before any key. Read directly when readable; a key receipt does not prove zoom.

view.zoom_check.scope: after confirmation of a proposed zoom entry
view.zoom_check.steps: Inspect actual scale/content first. Enter or a new screenshot does not prove the change. If readable, read directly. If still unreadable, choose one applicable visible fit/window/zoom command and check its effect; do not repeat numeric entry without a precise-ratio need.

view.readability.scope: reading goal or reported unreadability; inspect the current view
view.readability.steps: Readable now: read directly. Unreadable: choose ONE applicable visible fit command, window adjustment or frozen app zoom binding; verify app/focus, execute once, inspect readability. Use a numeric field only for a required precise ratio. Clipping is not clipboard cut.

menu.open.steps: Locate the named menu in the current image; open it once; inspect the expanded items before choosing. Do not substitute the document Open shortcut.

document.read.scope: focused scrollable document pane, not an input field
document.read.steps: Read the visible region directly if readable; do not adjust to an arbitrary percentage. Reuse source-bound reading claims only for unchanged content. Advance only for an unseen region, then compare content. If unreadable, choose one direct adjustment and inspect its effect.

window.maximize.scope: GNOME active window; verify it is not already maximized
window.maximize.steps: Toggle maximization once; inspect window bounds. This is a toggle: repeating it can undo the change. Re-locate controls after resizing.

view.zoom_in.scope: confirmed visible Zoom In control; relative increase is needed
view.zoom_in.steps: If already readable, read. Otherwise use the visible Zoom In command once and inspect readability/clipping. A frozen app binding is an alternative only after checking app/focus. Do not enter a number unless a precise ratio is required.

view.zoom_out.scope: confirmed visible Zoom Out control; relative decrease is needed
view.zoom_out.steps: If already readable with the needed bounds visible, read. Otherwise use the visible Zoom Out command once and inspect bounds/readability. A frozen app binding needs confirmed app/focus. Do not use numeric entry for an arbitrary percentage.

pointer.drag.scope: visible draggable object and destination; native computer tool
pointer.drag.steps: Locate source in the current image; mouse_move to its coordinate, then left_click_drag to the destination coordinate. Duration changes speed, not start position. Inspect actual movement; if unclear, re-ground or use an applicable menu/clipboard workflow.

image.edit.scope: visible editable image canvas; confirm layer, selection and active tool
image.edit.steps: Choose the applicable visible editing tool; inspect selection/affected region before an edit and the result after it. Repeated Delete without a changed selection is not evidence of progress. Check the whole requested result before finishing; export only when required by the public task.

window.locate.scope: a named application/window or desktop overview; focus unconfirmed
window.locate.steps: Locate the requested window in the current view or visible switcher; select it once and inspect its title/content. Do not use document Open as a window-switch command.

folder.open.scope: visible file manager, folder pane or location control
folder.open.steps: Locate the intended folder or location control; open/navigate once; inspect the displayed location. Do not substitute a document Open shortcut.

url.open.steps: Use the visible address control for the requested URL; inspect the destination page after navigation. Do not substitute document Open.

files.find.scope: file manager or file chooser with a visible file-search control
files.find.steps: Use the visible search control for the named file/folder; inspect the scope and matches. Do not assume content Find searches files.

document.save_as.scope: editable content whose File menu explicitly supports Save As; not Export
document.save_as.steps: Use the verified Save As command; inspect name, location and format; confirm and inspect the saved file. Do not substitute Save or assume format export.
